name: calmo
description: Connects Claude Code to calmo.cloud, the hosting platform for Odoo, and adds skills for working with it, starting with moving an existing Odoo onto calmo.cloud.

api_token.title: calmo.cloud API token
api_token.description: An API token of your team, created under Developer → API Tokens in the calmo.cloud panel. Use a token for this assistant only, so you can revoke it on its own.
